description.tr: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, Glasgow'un en ünlü sanat galerilerinden biridir ve zengin bir koleksiyona sahiptir.
description.en: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum is one of Glasgow's most famous art galleries and houses a rich collection.
description.de: Das Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum ist eines der bekanntesten Kunstmuseen von Glasgow und beherbergt eine reiche Sammlung.

description.tr: Glasgow Science Centre, bilim ve teknolojiye dair interaktif sergiler sunan büyük bir müzedir.
description.en: The Glasgow Science Centre is a large museum offering interactive exhibits related to science and technology.
description.de: Das Glasgow Science Centre ist ein großes Museum mit interaktiven Ausstellungen zu Wissenschaft und Technologie.

description.tr: The Lighthouse, Glasgow'un en önemli mimarlık ve tasarım merkezlerinden biridir.
description.en: The Lighthouse is one of Glasgow's most important architecture and design centers.
description.de: The Lighthouse ist eines der wichtigsten Architektur- und Designzentren in Glasgow.

description.tr: Glasgow Cathedral, 12. yüzyıldan kalma tarihi bir katedraldir ve Glasgow'un en eski yapılarından biridir.
description.en: Glasgow Cathedral is a historic 12th-century cathedral and one of the oldest buildings in Glasgow.
description.de: Die Glasgow Kathedrale ist eine historische Kathedrale aus dem 12. Jahrhundert und eines der ältesten Gebäude in Glasgow.

description.tr: Botanic Gardens, doğa severler için mükemmel bir mekan olup, çok sayıda bitki türünü görmek için harika bir yerdir.
description.en: The Botanic Gardens is an excellent place for nature lovers, offering a great spot to view a variety of plant species.
description.de: Die Botanischen Gärten sind ein hervorragender Ort für Naturliebhaber und bieten einen großartigen Platz, um eine Vielzahl von Pflanzenarten zu sehen.
